title: Structural component
provenance: Old Goa (Ruin of St. Augestine Church)
brief_description: The makhara torana panel depicted a human figure and a Makhara (crocodile) over the entrance of the girbagraha of an ancient Hindu temple. This window panel had once adorned the side wall of the girbagraha of a Hindu temple.
detailed_description: A monolithic architectural stone (most probably a piece of an ancient Hindu temple) depicting as one side a Makhara with its open mouth and shant on the other side a man with a round thing like a shield in the right hand. While the left hand is lifted up. Several upright standing rose the fielded diamonds with in a panel.
